verdict.rationale: Resend documents a first-party Suppressions API endpoint for adding an email address to the suppression list. That shows API-level management of suppressions exists, but the pack shows only the add operation. Nothing evidences listing or reading the list, removal, separate bounce, complaint and unsubscribe categories, or automatic blocking of re-sends to hard bounces. missing for 10: list/retrieve suppressions via API, delete/remove suppression endpoint, bounce vs complaint vs unsubscribe classification, documented automatic hard-bounce suppression on send, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can read and manage bounce, complaint, and unsubscribe suppression lists via the API so my app never re-emails a hard bounce

citations.quote: Add an email address to the suppression list.
